notes:
Helix around a curve, star polygons, richer polar arrays and a tidier title bar.

### New
- Helix AroundCurve: wind a helix round any curve; pick (or preselect) the curve, then the radius and start point. Turns or Pitch count along the curve.
- Polygon Star: centre, corner, then the second radius of the inner corners.
- Polar array: Items, StepAngle (the angle between items), Rotate=No to keep copies upright, and ZOffset to raise each item along the axis.
- Contour: Points picks a base point and a direction point, so contours can run in any direction.

### Improved
- Group and Ungroup ask for the objects when nothing is selected, and are always available in the Organize menu.
- ExplodeBlock now explodes nested blocks completely; Explode still works one level at a time.
- Project and Pull show their options while you select, and accept them there.
- Polygon shows the remembered radius from the start, like Circle; Enter accepts it.
- History: every step shows the icon and name of the command that made it, also from menus, panels and shortcuts.
- Unsaved changes appear as a dot beside the file name (hover for details); the file name stays visible in narrow windows.
- The pointer coordinates in the status bar are more compact.

### Fixed
- Curve Boolean offered a Keep option with no value; it now shows DeleteInput.
- The Preview button appears only once there is a valid selection.

---
Windows x64 installer with signed automatic updates and the corresponding AGPL source code. The installer is not Authenticode-signed: on first install choose **More info > Run anyway**.
